operations.description: Fetch metadata about Programmes (brands, series, episodes, clips). By applying different filter restrictions this feed can be used in many ways, for example to retrieve all series belonging to a brand, all the episodes and/or clips for a specific series, or any TLEO objects for a masterbrand. Other filters permit restricting to specific formats and/or genres, and you can request specific versions (for example Signed or Audio-Described). Parameters may be combined in any way suitable for your application.
operations.summary: Start here for programmes metadata: Brands, Series, Episodes and Clips
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list programmes [PATH] programmes [PARAMS] audio availability brand children descendants described direction duration embargoed end entity for format from genre group id initial item letter master media mixin name of page partner payment people pid promoted q scheme set signed size sort start strict tag tleo type version [SCHEMA] error model

operations.description: The versions feed exposes editorial "Versions" of programmes. These are concepts used to capture different presentations of an overall programme: for example, versions of a programme may include one with sign language, one with audio description, one edited for content and more. Versions are also important to understand for broadcasts: a linear broadcast or an ondemand is always of a specific version, not merely of a programme.
operations.summary: Metadata on editorial programme versions: original, signed, audio-described, etc
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] list versions [PATH] versions [PARAMS] availability descendants embargoed id media of page partner payment pid set size type [SCHEMA] error model
